name: Mad-Sad-Glad
description: Team members sort their feelings about the last period into mad, sad and glad. It makes emotions easy to talk about, which helps when the team is tense or tired.

columns.name: Sad
columns.prompt: What disappointed you or made you feel down?

columns.name: Glad
columns.prompt: What made you happy or proud?

mood.tired: Feelings are quick to write down and need little thinking.
mood.tense: Gives people a safe way to name what bothers them.

checkInQuestion: Which weather describes your mood today: sunny, cloudy, rainy or stormy?
facilitationTips: Say clearly that every feeling is welcome and nobody has to defend theirs.
Start the discussion with the Glad column so the session begins on a good note.
Focus on what causes a feeling, not on who is to blame.
